service.description: Orchestrates a staged prompt turn from APE, delegating to AI gateway and staging buffers.
Central dispatcher validating, storing, and executing AgiPayload envelopes according to the selected Assist Mode.

actions.script:
List results = [] rawList.each { pld -> def facetList = ec.entity.find("org.moqui.ai.payload.AgiPayloadFacet") .condition("agiPayloadId", pld.agiPayloadId) .list() Map facetMap = [:] facetList.each { f -> facetMap[f.facetKey] = f.facetValue }
results.add([ agiPayloadId: pld.agiPayloadId, title: pld.title ?: (pld.userPromptText?.take(45) + "..."), userPromptText: pld.userPromptText, modeEnumId: pld.modeEnumId, statusId: pld.statusId, artifactUri: pld.artifactUri, targetMariaId: pld.targetMariaId, lastUpdatedStamp: pld.lastUpdatedStamp?.toString(), facets: facetMap ]) } context.payloadList = results

service.description: Retrieves active Meta-JSON layout tree, self-healing stale or corrupted buffers automatically.
Stores or updates a Meta-JSON workspace layout buffer safely.

Recursively processes FreeMarker templates (.ftl) by expanding include directives, or converts a layoutTree AST map into standard Moqui screen XML strictly adhering to xml-screen-3.xsd schema order: parameter*, transition*, subscreens?, actions?, widgets.

Compiles layoutTree AST (if provided), sanitizes tags, validates syntax with Xerces, verifies that all referenced entities exist in Moqui/Mantle UDM, auto-stubs any declared subscreens missing from disk, and writes cleanly formatted XML.
Parses screen XML text (or reads from artifactUri) into native Meta-JSON AST, extracts root subscreens cleanly, and stamps canonical mariaIds.
Discovers all registered AgiArtifact DB records and scans runtime component directories for XML screens, Groovy services, entities, tests, and reports.
Deletes the in-memory/DB workspace buffer for an artifact or all artifacts for the current user.
Purges an artifact file from disk, deletes its DB workspace buffer, and clears screen/resource caches.
